task_description: Add unit test coverage for dashboard and admin page components focusing on products, categories, tables, and plans pages. These components contain complex business logic for CRUD operations, form validation, and state management that should be tested in isolation.

sub_components: ProductListItem - renders individual product in list
ProductForm - handles create/edit forms in both new and edit pages
functionality: List products with filtering by search and category
Create new products with price ledger integration
Edit existing products with immutable price history
state_management: fetchProducts - fetches products with current prices and category details
handleSubmit - creates/updates products and manages price ledger
handleToggleVisibility - toggles product visibility
handleDeleteConfirm - deletes products
Search and filter state (searchQuery, filterCategory)
business_logic: Immutable price ledger pattern (price changes create new entries)
Price change detection (only creates ledger entry if price changed)
Allergen parsing from comma-separated string to array

sub_components: CategoryTreeNode - recursive component for hierarchical category display
functionality: List categories in hierarchical tree structure
Create new categories with optional parent
Auto-generate URL slugs from category names
Support Turkish characters in slug generation
state_management: fetchCategories - fetches all categories sorted by sort_order
handleSubmit - creates/updates categories
handleToggleVisibility - toggles category visibility
handleDeleteConfirm - deletes categories with child check
business_logic: generateSlug - converts Turkish text to URL-safe slugs
Prevent circular parent-child relationships in edit mode
getAvailableParents - filters descendant categories from parent dropdown

sub_components: TableListItem - renders table with QR code preview and status
functionality: List restaurant tables with status indicators
Create new tables with auto-generated QR codes
Download QR codes in multiple formats (SVG, PNG, PDF)
state_management: fetchTables - fetches all tables sorted by table_number
handleSubmit - creates/updates tables
handleStatusChange - updates table status
handleDeleteConfirm - deletes tables
handleDownloadQR - generates and downloads QR codes in various formats
business_logic: QR code generation with organization slug and table UUID
Table statistics calculation (empty, occupied, service_needed counts)
File download handling for different formats
dependencies: QR code generation library (generateQRCodeSVG, generateQRCodePNG, generateQRCodePDF)

functionality: List all subscription plans with feature counts and subscriber counts
Create/edit plans with pricing and sort order
Assign features to plans with boolean or limit values
Tab-based UI for plans and features
Feature type support: boolean (on/off) and limit (numeric)
Dynamic plan system (no hard-coded plan checks)
state_management: fetchPlans - fetches plans with feature and subscriber counts
fetchFeatures - fetches all features from catalog
fetchPlanFeatures - fetches features assigned to specific plan
handlePlanSubmit - creates/updates plans
handleTogglePlan - toggles plan active status
handleFeatureSubmit - creates/updates features
handleTogglePlanFeature - toggles boolean feature for plan
handleUpdatePlanFeatureLimit - updates limit value for plan feature
business_logic: Limit value handling: -1 = unlimited, null = not set, positive number = limit
Feature key immutability (cannot change after creation)

patterns.test_structure: Describe-It pattern with clear test names
patterns.mocking: Mock Supabase client and external dependencies
patterns.test_data: Use factory functions for test data
